about: What the screens of the internal console show (work package D-04). Each block says where it comes from. A block whose `about` begins with "Sample:" is not measured: it stands for a state of the product that does not exist yet. Everything else is copied from the research spike spikes/minsk-city-data (docs/research/06-minsk-city-data.md) and is data of OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0), Wikidata (CC0 1.0) or Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).

people.about: Sample: people of the console, by first names of the scenarios of the specification, on a reserved example domain. Not real accounts.

source.what: Names are Wikidata labels; monthly_views is the mean of twelve months of page views of the Place's articles (null: the Place is outside the sample that was read); articles are the languages that have an article; heritage is the state list. sensitive_from "material": marked in 08-material.json; "kind": follows from the kind of the Place by the rule of 02-places.json (a place of worship → religion, a military object → war).
source.licence: Wikidata, CC0 1.0; page views: Wikimedia, CC0 1.0

states.about: Sample: which Dossier is a draft or stale, and the count of open Corrections, are states of the product; not measured.

dossier.about: The Dossier the editor shows is of the second Place of the reference Outing. Its facts are the sentences of the cited passage in story.json, one fact a sentence, each with the article revision cited there. No fact is written for the mockup.

sample.about: Sample: theme tags of each fact (indexes of the fixed theme list), which fact a Curator finds doubtful, the checks before verifying; not measured. The fact a Correction is attached to is the sentence of story.json → playing.

no_facts.about: A real Place nested in the Territory below, a memorial of the war: flagged sensitive by its kind. That its Dossier holds no confirmed fact is a sample of the state of KNW-6.

contradiction.about: Real: the two cited passages differ here — the Russian one names one architect, the English one two. It is shown as the form of a contradiction note; no fact is written for it.

source.what: The phrases chosen for the listening comparison of ADR-0014. `stressed` is the stress shown in the lead of the Russian Wikipedia article named in lead_title; null where the lead shows none.

states.about: Sample: the status of each entry, the wrong guess of the voice (`guess`), how many Narrations use a word, and the lengths of the audio; not measured. No Narration exists yet.

entries.text: Lošyca Park, Kurasoŭščyna Park and Janka Kupala Street

override.about: Real: an ordinary word of the cited Russian passage whose stress depends on its form. Sample: that the voice misread it and a Curator fixed its reading in this one Story.

source.file: spikes/minsk-city-data/out/minsk.duckdb (tables territory, place, place_parent, feature) and 02-places.json
source.what: The boundary, the Entrances (nodes tagged barrier=entrance on the boundary), the nested Places and the tags are copied from OpenStreetMap; the Wikidata identifier and the page views from Wikidata and 17-pageviews.json. Coordinates are in the units of map.json.
source.licence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; identifiers and labels: Wikidata, CC0 1.0

editor.about: Sample: values a Curator would set; not measured.

duplicate.about: Two objects of OpenStreetMap with the same name and the same Wikidata item, a few metres apart: a real pair for the merge of PLC-11.

parking.about: Real: the nearest parking area that is not private and the nearest bicycle parking, as OpenStreetMap has them (table feature of minsk.duckdb); the distance is a straight line from the centre of the Territory. That a Curator chose them as the parking points of the Place is a sample.

access.about: A real nested Place with opening hours on the map. The fourteen days are the horizon the research resolved hours for (03-hours.json → horizons.ordinary); the value "Mo-Su 10:00-19:00" opens every day from 10:00 to 19:00, written here in minutes of the day. Sample: the English name (proposed, marked as generated), the transliteration (made by the rule of the national Latin alphabet, marked as such) and the check date.

split.about: Real: two objects of OpenStreetMap that carry one Wikidata item, a theatre and the cinema building it is in. That the base holds them as one Place, to be split, is a sample of the state.

source.file: 23-diffs.json (examples) and the two extracts it compares
source.what: Objects of OpenStreetMap in the city whose tags changed between the extracts of 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-22: the old and the new value are the tags as they were in each. `day` is the day of the daily diff that carried the change.

rules.about: Which rule of ADR-0031 (point 11) a change falls under is a reading for the mockup: "closure" waits for a Curator in an opened area; "curator_set" assumes the Venue was selected and its hours set by a Curator (a sample); "fills_empty" is applied without a person.

history.about: Sample: who accepted a change and when; not measured. The creation record and the change itself are real.

held.about: Sample: a run held by the limit of ADR-0031, point 12. The share of the mass edit is real: in November 2024 one month holds the last edit of 20.9 % of the objects (22-freshness.json).

later_edit.about: Sample: a later edit by a Curator of the same attribute, which is why an earlier change can no longer be undone.

source.what: Pairs of a Wikidata item without a link from the map and an object of OpenStreetMap, proposed by the matcher at its medium setting. Names are as the sources have them, in Belarusian.

items.osm_name: Будынак былой Мінскай партыйнай школы 1957 г.

items.wikidata_name: Музей-майстэрня мастака З.І. Азгура (будынак, агароджа, дворык)

source.what: Counts and dates of what the research spike read from each Source.

runs.about: Sample: failed or throttled requests of the last run; not measured.

freshness_checks.about: The table of ADR-0031, point 15: what is checked and how often. last_run is the date the research spike read the Source; next_run is that date plus the interval. The switch is a sample.

source.what: The whole country, by kind: objects on the map, how many were edited within a year, how many carry a check date and how many of those within a year, and the material changes of thirty days.

runs.about: Sample: the ledger of runs of one Freshness Check. The first line is real where the research measured it: the date of the extract, the objects read, and the material changes of thirty days.

source.what: Venues within 215 m of the sixth Place of the reference Outing, as a straight line: names, kinds, opening hours and check dates as OpenStreetMap has them. Coordinates are in the units of map.json. The three marked selected are those of venues.json; the selection itself is a Curator's and is a sample.
The share of objects with opening hours on the map, by group, in the city.

key_places.about: Sample: the number of Key Places and how many of their Dossiers are verified; not measured. No Dossier exists yet.

preparation.about: Sample: a run of Preparation, its progress, failures and cost; not measured. No Preparation has run. The Places are those of the reference Outing; money is in US dollars and of the order the owner's budget allows.

area.about: Real: the box of the Route Pack of the reference Outing (outing.json → route_pack_area_bbox), in the units of map.json, and the number of candidate Places inside it (08-material.json).

dashboards.about: Sample: cost, ratings, trigger reliability and failures; not measured. Nothing of it exists before the product runs.

product.about: Sample: the measures of ANL-2 by week, activations, ratings of Stories by Place and language, and Corrections by status and age; not measured. Nothing of it exists before the product runs.

coverage_regions.about: Sample: Key Places and verified Dossiers per city or region. Only the reference city has been looked at; the others are shown as reviewed by nobody. The counts of objects are real (areas → freshness).

admin.about: Sample: limits, what each Plan grants, budgets and audit entries; not measured. The capabilities are the four of ENT-2.

rate_limits.about: Sample: the limits an Administrator can change (F-11, ADR-0028); not measured.

corrections.about: Sample: the Corrections of the inbox. The statement each is attached to is a sentence of the cited passage in story.json; the first is the one sent in SC-6 (story.json → playing). The claim is only its kind: no historical claim is written for a mockup. Place-data Corrections name Venues and changes that are real (see changes); that a person reported them is a sample.

source.what: Places and Territories of the city as the research holds them: names (Wikidata labels, or the name on the map), nested Places, tagged Entrances and the points where walkable ways cross the boundary, opening hours, the heritage list, monthly page views, and whether the Place lies within 1.5 km of the centre.

states.about: Sample: which Places are Key Places and how each got on the list (seeded from page views, from the heritage list, or added by a Curator), and the status. The flag "no_entrance" marks a real Territory with no tagged Entrance on the map; that the product would flag it is a reading for the mockup: every Territory of the research has paths crossing its boundary.

key_list.about: Sample: how the list of Key Places is made up; not measured.

name.en: House of Wańkowicz family in Minsk

source.what: Places of the city whose own website was reached and showed opening hours in its text: the Place, the host, the opening hours the base has from the map, and whether the parser could resolve that value.

fragment.about: Sample: the research keeps no text of a page, so no fragment exists. Where a fragment would stand, the mockup shows the opening-hours value the map already has, labelled as a sample of the form of a fragment; the hash of the page is a sample too.

source.what: Places to check in person: those whose website no longer answers, and Venues near the sixth Place of the reference Outing that have no website; with the check date the map carries, if any.

order.about: Sample: the order (by age of confirmation and importance) is a reading for the mockup.

source.what: Candidate Places in the box of the centre, in the rest of the city and in the rest of the country; and, for the city, the regional centres and the rest, the objects of the five kinds on the map with how many were edited within a year.

opened.about: Sample: which area is opened to a Curator, by whom and when; not measured.

operations.about: Sample: the operations view; not measured. Nothing runs in the cloud yet. The allowances of instance time and storage are the estimates of ADR-0024; every other number, date and result is a sample.

sign_in.about: Sample: the account that is refused is the sample person of samples.json; the version numbers of "update required" are samples.
